scope: Offline Pythonic source forms; no controller/native equivalence

joint_widths.input: Complete finite JOINTPOS1..9; padding zeros and zero-only trailing narrowing
joint_widths.ownership: Private differing-width source arguments, RETURN before cleanup, RHS before target capture; exact same-type aliases
joint_widths.boundary: Exact whole arrays, BYNAME, linked declarations and raw callback results; no model discovery or motion

xml_leaves.input: Explicit user STRUCTURE root with dotted record fields and complete one-based ARRAY indices
xml_leaves.types: INTEGER/BYTE/SHORT/finite REAL/BOOLEAN/bounded ASCII STRING; retain SHORT sentinel and unmentioned missing leaves
xml_leaves.atomicity: Stage checked independent value; reject canonical duplicates, protected POSITION fields and CONFIG overflow; publish preserving identities
xml_leaves.boundary: No XML writing/namespaces, native layouts or live parser JSON checkpoints

question_files.input: COPY/DELETE/RENAME/MOVE final-basename source ? matches exactly one character; * matches zero or more
question_files.destination: Only existing full-stem/extension star substitution; question templates return invalid status
question_files.publication: Retain sorted bounded preflight and ordinary/plain-PIP guards; rooted host batch publication may remain partial on host failure

strict_mode: Future milestone; legacy cross-width source guards preserved
